tasks.title: Enumerate every Archive.org file
tasks.task: Fix Archive.org search/link retrieval failures reported in dist_final_5/pkg_down.log. Search every result page and list every individual file from every Archive.org item (not merely torrent files), with robust request, pagination, URL encoding, error reporting, and cancellation behavior. Preserve the optional extension filter and produce a verified Windows executable.

tasks.title: Persistent settings and flat download paths
tasks.task: Persist search text, file-type filter, result sort column/direction, and download directory across runs in a stable per-user settings file. Fall back to the Windows Downloads folder when the saved destination is unavailable. Download every selected file directly into the chosen folder without Archive.org item/page subdirectories, and fix already-downloaded detection to use that flat destination and exact expected file size. Verify the behavior and create a new executable folder without overwriting or stopping the current executable.

requirements.text: Settings persist search text, extension filter, sort column/direction, download directory, and search history across build folders
An unavailable saved download directory falls back safely to the user Downloads folder
Download destinations use a safe basename directly inside the selected folder with no Archive.org identifier or source subfolders
Already-downloaded detection checks the flat destination, distinguishes complete and incomplete files by expected size, refreshes correctly, and skips complete files
Automated and GUI smoke tests cover settings, fallback, flat paths, and complete-file detection
A verified Windows executable is built in a new dist folder and recorded as latestExePath without touching older running builds

tasks.title: Download stopping, storage preview, and ETAs
tasks.task: Add a Stop Downloads control that safely cancels the active partial transfer and clears queued downloads; show the combined size of selected results and free space on the volume containing the selected download folder; show separate ETA values for the current file and all queued files. Preserve completed files, clean only app-owned partial files, verify behavior, and create a fresh executable in a new dist folder without touching the running older build.

requirements.text: Stop Downloads cancels the active transfer, clears queued transfers, cleans app-owned .part files, updates row states and counters, and permits new downloads afterward
Selection UI previews total known bytes, unknown-size count, free space, and remaining space on the volume containing the selected download folder
The status bar displays separately updated current-file ETA and all-queued-files ETA, handling unknown sizes and idle states honestly
Automated and GUI smoke tests verify cancellation state, storage calculations, ETA calculations, and UI controls
A verified Windows executable is built in a new folder and recorded as the latest release path without stopping older running builds

tasks.title: Live filename filtering and hide downloaded
tasks.task: Add a real-time filename filter that updates the visible result list on every text change and matches only the individual file basename, case-insensitively. Add a Hide Downloaded toggle that removes verified-complete files while retaining Ready and Incomplete files. Make both filters compose correctly with sorting, selection, status refreshes, download completion, folder changes, and repeated Archive searches. Persist the filter controls with the existing settings and build a verified executable in a new folder without overwriting or stopping the current build.

requirements.text: Typing or deleting each character updates the table immediately using a case-insensitive substring match against only the individual file basename
Hide Downloaded excludes exact-size complete and unverified-existing files while keeping Ready and Incomplete files visible, and reacts to status or folder changes
Combined filters preserve correct sorting, visible/total counts, safe visible selection behavior, and clean repeated searches without detached-row collisions
Filename filter text and Hide Downloaded state persist with the existing per-user settings
Automated and GUI smoke tests verify live filtering, toggle behavior, combined filters, status transitions, sorting, and saved state
A verified Windows executable is built in a new dist folder and recorded as latestExePath without touching older running builds

notes.text: Implemented a persisted real-time, case-insensitive basename filter and persisted Hide Downloaded toggle. Filtering uses detachable rows to preserve the full result set, clears hidden selection, reports visible/total counts, preserves sorting, reacts to completion/deletion/folder refresh, keeps incomplete and Ready files visible, and safely clears detached rows between searches. Verified 26 unit tests, GUI filtering/restart smoke, and isolated packaged startup.
